source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 9 (PDF 122-140), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Cybersecurity and Safe Digital Collaboration) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Name any three safe digital habits mentioned in Section 9.1.
(Section 9.1 mein batayi gayi koi teen mehfooz digital aadatein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Strong passwords istemal karna.
2. Software update rakhna.
3. Ghair-mehfooz websites se bachna.
Yeh aadatein data loss, hacking aur identity theft se bachati hain.

book_ref.quote: using strong passwords, keeping software updated, and avoiding unsafe websites

blocks.prompt:
2 Define online safety. What three things should a user be careful about?
(Online safety ki definition likhein. User ko kin teen cheezon mein ehtiyat karni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Online safety ka matlab hai internet istemal karte hue apni aur apni maloomat ki hifazat. User ko ehtiyat karni chahiye ke kya share kare, kahan click kare aur data kaise store kare.

book_ref.quote: It includes being careful about what you share, where you click, and how you store your data.

blocks.prompt:
3 What is meant by a digital footprint? Why should it make users careful online?
(Digital footprint se kya muraad hai? Yeh users ko online mohtaat kyun banaye?)
blocks.explanation: Online kaam digital footprints (nishanat) chhorte hain jinhein track kiya ja sakta hai. Is liye users ko share aur click karte hue mohtaat rehna chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Students learn that online actions leave digital footprints that can be tracked.

blocks.prompt:
4 Give two rules for making a strong password.
(Strong password banane ke do usool likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Letters, numbers aur symbols mila kar likhein.
2. Naam ya birthday jaisi zaati maloomat se bachein.
(Saath hi: har account ka alag password, waqtan fawaqtan badlein aur kisi se share na karein.)

book_ref.quote: It's best to avoid personal details like names or birthdays.

blocks.prompt:
5 Why should a different password be used for each account?
(Har account ke liye alag password kyun rakhna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Har account ka alag (unique) password hack hone ka imkaan kam karta hai: aik password chori ho jaye to baqi accounts mehfooz rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Using unique passwords for different accounts reduces the chance of being hacked.

blocks.prompt:
6 What is unsafe browsing? Give two examples.
(Unsafe browsing kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Unsafe browsing web ka laparwah istemal hai jo fraud ya identity theft ka sabab ban sakta hai. Misalein: (1) jaali websites kholna, (2) na-maloom links par click karna.

book_ref.quote: Unsafe browsing, such as visiting fake websites or clicking unknown links, can also lead to scams or identity theft.

blocks.prompt:
7 Define software maintenance. Write two things that software updates do.
(Software maintenance ki definition likhein. Software updates ke do kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Software maintenance ka matlab hai programs ko baqaidagi se update kar ke achhi halat mein rakhna. Updates (1) errors theek aur performance behtar karte hain, (2) naye features dete aur security gaps band karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Software maintenance means keeping programs and applications in good working condition by updating them regularly.

blocks.prompt:
8 Write two risks of using outdated software.
(Purana (outdated) software istemal karne ke do khatre likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Purane versions mein security holes ho sakte hain jin se files ya zaati data tak baghair ijazat rasai ho jaye (malware aur data breach ka khatra).
2. Purana software naye systems ya tools ke saath compatibility ke masail paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Older versions may have security holes that allow unauthorized access to files or personal data.

blocks.prompt:
9 What are privacy and security settings? Where are they found?
(Privacy aur security settings kya hain? Yeh kahan milti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Privacy aur security settings users ko batati hain ke un ki zaati maloomat (location, contacts, browsing history) online kaise istemal aur share ho. Yeh zyada tar apps, websites aur digital platforms mein hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Privacy and security settings help users control how their personal information is used and shared online.

blocks.prompt:
10 Give two settings an Instagram user can change to protect privacy and security.
(Instagram user privacy aur security ke liye kaun si do settings badal sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Account private karein taake sirf approved followers posts dekhein (ya location sharing band karein).
2. Extra hifazat ke liye two-factor authentication on karein.

book_ref.quote: They can also turn off location sharing to protect their privacy and enable two-factor authentication for extra account security.

blocks.prompt:
11 What two things should a user check while reading a privacy policy?
(Privacy policy parhte hue user ko kin do baaton ko check karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: User ko check karna chahiye ke (1) kis qism ka data jama ho raha hai (naam, email, location, browsing activity, app usage) aur (2) kis maqsad ke liye, aur kya yeh advertisers ya third-party services ko diya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Students learn to check what kind of data is being collected and for what purpose.

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between privacy settings and a privacy policy.
(Privacy settings aur privacy policy mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Privacy settings woh options hain jo user badalta hai; privacy policy platform ki taraf se bayan hai.

book_ref.quote: A privacy policy tells users how their data is collected, used, stored, and shared.

rows: Platform ke options jo user khud badalta hai
Website ya app ki likhi hui tehreer
Control karti hain ke posts kaun dekhe, kaun rabta kare aur data kaise istemal ho
Batati hai ke data kaise jama, istemal, store aur share hota hai
Misal: Instagram account private karna
Misal: social platform batata hai ke woh naam, email aur location jama karta hai

blocks.prompt:
13 Name two features that increase safety when customizing platform settings.
(Platform settings customize karte hue hifazat barhane wale do features ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Two-factor authentication on karna.
2. App permissions mehdood karna.
User ko settings baqaidagi se dekhni chahiyein kyunke platforms privacy rules badalte rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Turning on features like two-factor authentication and limiting app permissions increases safety.

blocks.prompt:
14 Write two privacy options available on WhatsApp.
(WhatsApp par dastiyab do privacy options likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Profile photo kaun dekhe: everyone, sirf contacts ya nobody.
2. Read receipts (blue ticks) band karna taake doosre na dekh sakein ke message parha gaya ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: They can also disable read receipts, commonly known as blue ticks

blocks.prompt:
15 Give two safety steps while sharing a Google Docs file for group work.
(Group kaam ke liye Google Docs file share karte hue do hifazati qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Document sirf bharosemand classmates ko share karein.
2. Agar doosron ko sirf parhna ho to permission "Edit" ke bajaye "View only" rakhein. Is se document ghair-zaroori tabdeeli se bachta hai.

book_ref.quote: This helps protect the document from unwanted changes and keeps the work secure.

blocks.prompt:
16 Name two secure collaboration platforms. Which two features keep their data safe?
(Do secure collaboration platforms ke naam likhein. Kaun se do features un ka data mehfooz rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Platforms: Google Workspace aur Microsoft Teams. Yeh encrypted communication aur access controls se data mehfooz rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Choosing trusted and approved platforms helps protect information and reduces cyber risks.

blocks.prompt:
17 What does digital etiquette include? Give two points.
(Digital etiquette mein kya shamil hai? Do nukaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Munasib zubaan aur doosron ki raye ka ehtiram.
2. Communication tools ka ghalat istemal na karna, maslan sanjeeda taleemi baat mein spam, memes ya mazaq na bhejna aur zaati maloomat share na karna.

book_ref.quote: It includes using appropriate language, respecting others

blocks.prompt:
18 What is cybersecurity awareness? Why is it needed?
(Cybersecurity awareness kya hai? Is ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cybersecurity awareness ka matlab hai computers, networks aur data ko hamlon se bachane ki samajh. Is ki zaroorat hai kyunke cyber khatre aam hain; inhein pehchanna, rokna aur jawab dena data ko mehfooz rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Knowing how to detect, prevent, and respond to threats keeps personal and organizational data secure.

blocks.prompt:
19 Why should public Wi-Fi not be used for online banking?
(Online banking ke liye public Wi-Fi kyun istemal nahin karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Public networks shayad secure na hon, is liye un par online banking jaisa hassas kaam passwords aur data ko khatre mein daal sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: because public networks may not be secure

blocks.prompt:
20 Define cyber threats. How can most attacks be avoided?
(Cyber threats ki definition likhein. Zyada tar hamlon se kaise bacha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyber threats woh actions ya programs hain jo computers aur networks ko nuqsan pohanchate hain. Zyada tar hamlon se safe browsing, antivirus aur emails/links mein ehtiyat se bacha ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Most attacks can be avoided by safe browsing, using antivirus software, and being cautious with emails and links.

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between a virus and spyware.
(Virus aur spyware mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Virus data kharab ya delete karta hai; spyware chupke se maloomat jama karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A virus spreads through infected files and can damage or delete data.

rows: Infected files ke zariye phailta hai
Aksar na-maloom websites ke downloads mein chhupa hota hai
Data kharab ya delete kar sakta hai
Chupke se user ki maloomat jama karta hai
Is ka asar aam taur par nazar aata hai (files zaya)
User ke ilm ya ijazat ke baghair kaam karta hai

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between ransomware and phishing.
(Ransomware aur phishing mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ransomware paise ke liye data lock karta hai; phishing dhoke se maloomat hasil karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Ransomware locks data and demands payment to unlock it

rows: Malware ki aik qism
Jaali emails, messages ya websites se dhoka (cyberattack)
Data ya system lock karta hai
Logon se passwords ya zaati maloomat hasil karta hai
Kholne ke liye paise maangta hai
Churayi gayi maloomat fraud ya identity theft mein istemal hoti hai

blocks.prompt:
23 What is a DDoS attack?
(DDoS attack kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: DDoS ka matlab Distributed Denial of Service hai. Yeh hamla website par itna bojh daalta hai ke woh crash ho kar users ke liye band ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks overload websites, making them crash.

blocks.prompt:
24 Define malware. Name two kinds of malware from the chapter.
(Malware ki definition likhein. Chapter se malware ki do qismein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Malware woh nuqsan deh software hai jo computer kharab kare, data churaye ya system ka aam kaam bigaare. Misalein: virus, ransomware (aur spyware).

book_ref.quote: Malware is harmful software designed to damage a computer, steal data, or disturb normal system operations.

blocks.prompt:
25 How do cyberattacks affect organizations? Give two effects.
(Cyberattacks idaron (organizations) par kaise asar daalte hain? Do asraat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Companies ko data breaches aur customers ke aitmaad ke khatme ka saamna hota hai.
2. Hamle karobar rok dete, saakh kharab karte aur maali nuqsan karte hain. Schools aur hospitals bhi mutasir hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Attacks can stop business operations, harm reputations, and lead to financial losses.

blocks.prompt:
26 What are security tools and techniques? Name three.
(Security tools aur techniques kya hain? Teen ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Security tools aur techniques computers aur networks ko online khatron se bachate hain aur hackers ke liye ahem maloomat tak pohanchna mushkil banate hain. Misalein: authentication systems, firewalls, antivirus programs.

book_ref.quote: They make it harder for hackers or malicious software to access important information.

blocks.prompt:
27 Give an example of Two-Factor Authentication in use.
(Two-Factor Authentication ke istemal ki aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: User pehle password dalta hai; phir us ke phone ya email par code aata hai jise dal kar shanakht confirm hoti hai. Dono qadam ke baad hi rasai milti hai.

book_ref.quote: For example, after entering a password, the user may receive a code on their phone or email to confirm their identity.

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between Two-Factor Authentication and biometric verification.
(Two-Factor Authentication aur biometric verification mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 2FA do tasdeeqat maangta hai; biometrics jism ke features istemal karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Biometrics add strong layers of protection to keep accounts and personal data safe.

rows: Rasai se pehle do tasdeeqat maangta hai
Shanakht ke liye jismani features istemal karti hai
Misal: password aur phone/email par aaya code
Misal: fingerprint, face scan ya awaaz ka pattern
Extra qadam hackers ke liye ghusna mushkil banata hai
Accounts aur data ko mazboot hifazati tabaqe deti hai

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between a firewall and an Intrusion Detection System (IDS).
(Firewall aur Intrusion Detection System (IDS) mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Firewall nuqsan deh traffic rokta hai; IDS network par nazar rakh kar khabardar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A firewall acts as a barrier between a computer and the internet

rows: Computer aur internet ke darmiyan deewar
Networks par mashkook sargarmiyon ki nigrani
Mehfooz data guzarne deta, nuqsan deh traffic rokta hai
Users ko mumkina khatron se khabardar karta hai
Aane jane wali traffic ko security rules se control karta hai
Detect aur report karta hai; network ki sargarmi dekhta hai

blocks.prompt:
30 What is the role of antivirus software?
(Antivirus software ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antivirus software files scan karta hai aur virus ya malware ko nuqsan se pehle nikal deta hai. Firewall aur IDS ke saath mil kar yeh cyberattacks ke khilaf mazboot difa banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Antivirus software scans files and removes viruses or malware before they cause damage.

blocks.prompt:
31 Define data protection.
(Data protection ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Data protection ka matlab hai digital maloomat ko baghair ijazat rasai, zaya hone ya nuqsan se bachana, taake sirf sahi log hi data dekh ya istemal kar sakein.

book_ref.quote: It ensures that only the right people can view or use the data.

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between encryption and decryption.
(Encryption aur decryption mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Encryption data ko chhupata hai; decryption use wapas laata hai.

book_ref.quote: Encryption changes readable data into coded text using a specific key

rows: Parhne wale data ko coded text banati hai
Coded text ko wapas asal shakal mein laati hai
Aik khaas key istemal karti hai
Jab authorized user ko data chahiye tab hoti hai
Raste mein pakarne wale ke liye message na-qabil-e-faham bana deti hai
Authorized wusool kunanda ko message parhne deti hai

blocks.prompt:
33 Define cryptography. Write two of its uses.
(Cryptography ki definition likhein. Is ke do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cryptography maloomat ko is tarah mehfooz karne ka ilm hai ke sirf authorized users samjhein. Istemal: secure websites aur online banking (aur messaging apps).

book_ref.quote: Cryptography is widely used in secure websites, online banking, and messaging apps.

blocks.prompt:
34 Write two secure methods for transmitting and storing data.
(Data bhejne aur store karne ke do mehfooz tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Encrypted connections (jaise HTTPS) bhejte waqt maloomat mehfooz rakhte hain.
2. Encryption wali cloud storage saved files tak baghair ijazat rasai rokti hai; baqaidagi se backups data zaya hone se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: Data must be protected not only when stored on a computer but also when sent over the internet.

blocks.prompt:
35 Why are regular backups important?
(Baqaidagi se backups kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Baqaidagi se backups system ki kharabi ya hamlon se data zaya hone se bachate hain; hamle ke baad data backup se wapas laya ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Regular backups help protect data from loss caused by system failure or attacks.

blocks.prompt:
36 What is meant by detecting and preventing intrusions?
(Intrusions ko detect aur prevent karne se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka matlab hai computer ya network tak baghair ijazat rasai ko pehchanna aur rokna. Monitoring tools aur security software ghair-maamooli sargarmi pakarte hain; jaldi pehchan bare nuqsan se bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: Monitoring tools and security software help track unusual activity that might indicate an attack.

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between a vulnerability and a suspicious activity.
(Vulnerability aur suspicious activity mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Vulnerability kamzori hai; suspicious activity khatre ki nishani hai.

book_ref.quote: Vulnerabilities are weaknesses in software, hardware, or user behavior that hackers can exploit.

rows: Software, hardware ya user ke rawayye ki kamzori
System par nazar aane wali ghair-maamooli nishani
Hackers is se faida utha kar hamla kar sakte hain
Zahir kar sakti hai ke hamla ho raha hai
Jaldi pehchan kar theek karni chahiye
Misalein: achanak aahista hona, na-maloom programs, ajeeb network traffic

blocks.prompt:
38 Write any four preventive measures against a security issue.
(Security masle ke khilaf koi chaar ehtiyati iqdamat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Firewalls, antivirus aur anti-malware install karna.
2. Software update karna.
3. Passwords badalna.
4. Nuqsan deh files hatana (aur zaroorat ho to backup se data wapas lana).

book_ref.quote: Preventive measures include installing firewalls, antiviruses and anti-malware, updating software, changing passwords, or removing harmful files.

blocks.prompt:
39 Why should a security problem and its fix be documented?
(Security masle aur us ke hal ko likh kar kyun rakhna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Masla aur uthaye gaye qadam likhna use dobara hone se rokta hai, kyunke wajah aur hal aainda ke liye mehfooz ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Documenting the problem and the steps taken helps prevent it from happening again.

blocks.text: 9.3 Digital Collaboration and Equity in Computing

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between digital collaboration and equity in computing.
(Digital collaboration aur equity in computing mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Collaboration mil kar kaam hai; equity insaaf aur barabar rasai hai.

book_ref.quote: Combining collaboration with fairness helps create inclusive and effective learning and working environments.

rows: Technology se mushtarka kaam, projects ya ideas par mil kar kaam
Har shakhs ki digital wasail tak barabar rasai yaqeeni banana
Log mukhtalif jagahon se jur kar hissa daalte hain
Pas-e-manzar ya salahiyat se qata nazar sab par lagu
Teamwork, communication aur zimmedari par mabni
Insaaf aur shamooliyat par mabni

blocks.prompt:
41 What is the key to successful online teamwork?
(Kamyab online teamwork ki kunji kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Saaf communication aur baahami ehtiram kamyab online teamwork ki kunji hain. Online mil kar kaam teams ko aik jagah hue baghair ideas aur feedback share karne aur kaam mukammal karne deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Students understand that clear communication and mutual respect are key to successful online teamwork.

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is effective communication important in a digital team?
(Digital team mein mo'assar communication kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mo'assar communication ghalat fehmiyon se bachati hai aur sab members ko kaam ki pesh raft se baakhabar rakhti hai. Group chats, emails aur video calls team ko jore rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Effective communication prevents misunderstandings and ensures that all members stay informed about progress.

blocks.prompt:
43 What are real-time collaboration tools? Name two.
(Real-time collaboration tools kya hain? Do ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Real-time collaboration tools kai users ko aik hi waqt mein aik project par kaam karne dete hain; teams kaam tarteeb deti, files mil kar edit karti aur fauran update rehti hain. Misalein: Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams (aur Zoom).

book_ref.quote: These tools help teams organize tasks, edit files together, and stay updated instantly.

blocks.prompt:
44 What is meant by equal access? What does it include?
(Equal access se kya muraad hai? Is mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Equal access ka matlab hai har shakhs ko technology aur internet istemal karne ka barabar mauqa mile. Is mein bharosemand devices, internet connection aur digital skills tak rasai shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: This includes access to reliable devices, internet connections, and digital skills.

blocks.prompt:
45 Name three challenges that can stop people from equal access to technology.
(Teen aisi mushkilat likhein jo logon ko technology tak barabar rasai se rok sakti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Mazoori (disabilities).
2. Zubaan ki rukawat.
3. Wasail ki kami.
In masail ko samajh kar developers aise hal banate hain jo sab tak pohanchein.

book_ref.quote: Some people may face challenges such as disabilities, language barriers, or lack of resources.

blocks.prompt:
46 What are inclusive applications? Give two features that make an app inclusive.
(Inclusive applications kya hain? App ko inclusive banane wale do features likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Inclusive applications mukhtalif qism ke users ki zarooriyat poori karne ke liye banayi jati hain. Features: nazar se mazoor ke liye screen readers, videos ke subtitles, kai zubaanon ke options, saada layout aur saaf text (koi do).

book_ref.quote: Simple layouts and clear text also make apps easier to use for beginners.

blocks.prompt:
47 Name the five strategies for effective collaboration given in the chapter.
(Chapter mein di gayi mo'assar collaboration ki paanch strategies ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Roles assign karna.
2. Tasks manage karna.
3. Team goals tay karna.
4. Mil kar kaam ke tajurbaat par ghaur.
5. Teamwork behtar karne ke liye guftagu.

book_ref.quote: Collaboration also teaches us how to respect different opinions and work toward a common goal.

blocks.prompt:
48 Why are clear roles assigned in a team? Give an example.
(Team mein wazeh roles kyun diye jate hain? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Wazeh roles har member ko batate hain ke use kya karna hai. Misal: aik research kare, doosra maloomat tarteeb de aur teesra aakhri presentation banaye.

book_ref.quote: Clear roles help each team member know exactly what they need to do.

blocks.prompt:
49 How do managing tasks and setting team goals help a team?
(Tasks manage karna aur team goals tay karna team ki kaise madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Checklists ya timelines se tasks sambhalna team ko sahi raah par rakhta aur der se bachata hai. Mushtarka goals sab ko simt dete aur taawun barhate hain; wazeh roles aur goals se teamwork aasan aur behtar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: When roles and goals are clear, teamwork becomes much easier and more efficient.

blocks.prompt:
50 What is reflecting on collaborative experiences? Give one strength and one weakness it may find.
(Collaborative tajurbaat par ghaur (reflection) kya hai? Is se milne wali aik taaqat aur aik kamzori likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Project mukammal hone ke baad team sochti hai ke kya achha raha aur kya behtar ho sakta tha. Taaqat: achhi communication. Kamzori: missed deadlines (waqt par kaam na hona).

book_ref.quote: After completing a project, it is helpful for students to think about what went well and what could be improved.

blocks.prompt:
51 Define digital entrepreneurship. Name two platforms entrepreneurs use to reach customers.
(Digital entrepreneurship ki definition likhein. Customers tak pohanchne ke liye do platforms ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Digital entrepreneurship technology aur online platforms se karobari ideas banana, chalana aur barhana hai. Platforms: social media aur e-commerce websites (aur freelancing platforms).

book_ref.quote: Entrepreneurs use social media, e-commerce websites, and freelancing platforms to reach customers globally.

blocks.prompt:
52 Write any four characteristics of successful entrepreneurs.
(Kamyab entrepreneurs ki koi chaar khoobiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Takhleeqi, hamesha naye ideas ki talash.
2. Mehnati aur goals ke paband.
3. Pur-aitmaad aur soch samajh kar risk lene wale.
4. Faisla saazi aur masail hal karne ki mazboot salahiyat (aur badalte market mein dhalne wale).

book_ref.quote: They have strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.

blocks.prompt:
53 Name three areas where the digital economy is creating jobs in Pakistan.
(Pakistan mein digital economy kin teen shobon mein naukriyan paida kar rahi hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Software development.
2. Digital marketing.
3. Online services.
Yeh taraqqi naujawanon ko naukri dhoondne ke bajaye naukri dene wala banne par ubhaarti hai.

book_ref.quote: The digital economy is creating new job opportunities in areas such as software development, digital marketing, and online services.

blocks.prompt:
54 What is meant by identifying business opportunities? How do entrepreneurs find them?
(Karobari mauqe pehchanne se kya muraad hai? Entrepreneurs inhein kaise dhoondte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka matlab hai muashre ke woh masail dhoondna jo products ya services se hal hon. Entrepreneurs rozmarra zindagi dekh kar customers ki zarooriyat samajhte hain; technology online education, e-commerce aur digital services jaise mauqe dikhati hai.

book_ref.quote: Entrepreneurs observe daily life to understand customer needs and market demands.

blocks.prompt:
55 Give two examples of technology solving real-world problems.
(Technology ke zariye haqeeqi masail hal hone ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Online learning platforms talaba ko ghar se parhne dete hain.
2. Mobile apps kisanon ko fasal ki paidawar barhane mein madad deti hain. (Aur: digital payment systems len den aasan aur mehfooz banate hain.)

book_ref.quote: Digital payment systems make financial transactions easier and safer.

blocks.prompt:
56 What is meant by recognizing market needs? Name two ways to identify gaps in the market.
(Market ki zarooriyat pehchanne se kya muraad hai? Market ke khala pehchanne ke do tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Market ki zarooriyat pehchanne ka matlab hai samajhna ke log kya chahte hain aur kin masail ka saamna karte hain. Khala surveys aur feedback (aur online data) se pehchane jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Recognizing market needs and customer demands means understanding what people want and what problems they face.

blocks.prompt:
57 Differentiate between social media and e-commerce platforms as business tools.
(Karobari tools ke taur par social media aur e-commerce platforms mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Social media karobar ki tashheer karta hai; e-commerce platforms khareed o farokht karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Social media helps in promoting products and reaching a large audience quickly.

rows: Products ki promotion ke liye
Cheezon aur services ki khareed o farokht ke liye
Jaldi bari audience tak pohanchta hai
Baghair jismani dukaan ke sellers ko customers se jorta hai
Karobar ki pehchan banata hai
Users products dekhte, qeematein milate aur online order karte hain

blocks.prompt:
58 How do e-commerce platforms support digital entrepreneurship?
(E-commerce platforms digital entrepreneurship ki kaise madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh karobar ko baghair jismani dukaan ke internet par bechne dete hain, khareed o farokht aasan, tez aur zyada logon tak pohanchne wali banate hain. Kharche kam aur market bari karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They play an important role in supporting digital entrepreneurship by reducing costs and expanding market reach.

blocks.prompt:
59 Differentiate between freelancing and remote work.
(Freelancing aur remote work mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Freelancer clients ko apni skills deta hai; remote worker kahin se bhi company ke liye kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Freelancers can work in areas such as graphic design, writing, programming, and digital marketing.

rows: Online platforms ke zariye clients ko apni skills aur services dena
Ghar ya internet wali kisi jagah se company ke liye kaam
Graphic design, writing, programming aur digital marketing jaise shobe
Company ke daftar gaye baghair us ke liye kaam
Freelancer clients se khud mukhtar aamdani kamata hai
Lachak aur aalami job market tak rasai deta hai

blocks.prompt:
60 Write the steps of planning a small digital business.
(Chhote digital karobar ki planning ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Customers ki zaroorat poori karne wala product ya service chunein.
2. Target audience, qeemat aur digital platforms se delivery ka tareeqa tay karein.
3. Kharchon aur mutawaqqa aamdani ke liye basic budget banayein.

book_ref.quote: They then decide on the target audience, pricing, and method of delivery using digital platforms.

blocks.prompt:
61 Differentiate between budgeting and resource management.
(Budgeting aur resource management mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Budgeting paison ki planning hai; resource management saman, skills aur tools ke istemal ki planning hai.

book_ref.quote: Proper resource management ensures that materials, skills, and tools are used efficiently without waste.

rows: Karobar ke paison ki planning
Saman, skills, tools aur waqt ki planning
Kharchon ka andaza, qeematein aur aamdani-kharch sambhalna
Wasail ko baghair zaya kiye behtar istemal karna
Munafa barqarar rakhne mein madad
Taweel muddat ki kamyabi mein madad

blocks.prompt:
62 Why are teamwork and communication essential in a startup?
(Startup mein teamwork aur communication kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Team members ideas, zimmedariyan aur skills share kar ke mushtarka goals hasil karte hain. Mo'assar communication ghalat fehmi se bachati aur faislon ko behtar karti hai; is se paidawar aur karobar barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Effective communication helps avoid misunderstandings and improves decision-making.

blocks.prompt:
63 Define innovation. Why is it important in digital entrepreneurship?
(Innovation ki definition likhein. Digital entrepreneurship mein yeh kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Innovation naye aur behtar ideas, products ya services banana hai jo masail behtar hal karein. Yeh digital karobar ko barhne aur market mein muqabla karne ke qabil rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: In digital entrepreneurship, innovation helps businesses grow and stay competitive in the market.

blocks.prompt:
64 Name four emerging technologies. How do they help entrepreneurs?
(Chaar emerging technologies ke naam likhein. Yeh entrepreneurs ki kaise madad karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Artificial intelligence, cloud computing, blockchain aur mobile applications. Yeh kharche kam, paidawar behtar aur digital platforms se aalami rasai mumkin banati hain.

book_ref.quote: They reduce costs, improve productivity, and enable global reach through digital platforms.

blocks.prompt:
65 What is the role of mobile apps and digital services in business?
(Karobar mein mobile apps aur digital services ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mobile apps karobar ko customers tak pohanchne, products bechne aur jaldi services dene mein aasani deti hain. Online payments, cloud storage aur marketing tools karkardagi barhate aur kharche kam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Mobile apps make it easier for businesses to reach customers, sell products, and provide services quickly.

blocks.prompt:
66 Name any four career pathways in technology entrepreneurship.
(Technology entrepreneurship mein koi chaar career raaste likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Startup founder.
2. Freelancer (programming, graphic design, digital marketing).
3. App developer ya e-commerce manager.
4. Online consultant (aur naye digital hal banane wala innovator).

book_ref.quote: Careers in app development, e-commerce management, and online consultancy are also growing rapidly.

blocks.text: 9.5 Ethical, Legal, and Environmental Impacts of Computing

blocks.prompt:
67 Differentiate between ethical use and legal use of technology.
(Technology ke ethical aur legal istemal mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethical istemal munsifana aur zimmedarana faisle hain; legal istemal qanoon ki pabandi hai.

book_ref.quote: Ethical use involves making fair and responsible choices when using digital tools.

rows: Digital tools istemal karte hue munsifana aur zimmedarana faisle
Technology se mutaliq qawaneen ki pabandi
Privacy, insaaf aur maloomat ki sahi dekh bhaal
Cybercrime aur data privacy qawaneen maanna
Ghair-akhlaqi kaam aitmaad aur saakh kharab karte hain
Qanoon torne par qanooni saza hoti hai

blocks.prompt:
68 What does ethical use of technology include? Give two points.
(Technology ke ethical istemal mein kya shamil hai? Do nukaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Privacy, insaaf aur maloomat ki sahi dekh bhaal ka ehtiram.
2. Technology ke faislon ke logon, idaron aur muashre par asraat ka khayal. Ethical usool online aitmaad aur hifazat barqarar rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Decisions in technology should consider the potential effects on people, organizations, and society.

blocks.prompt:
69 Differentiate between intellectual property and data ownership.
(Intellectual property aur data ownership mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Intellectual property takhleeqi kaam se mutaliq hai; data ownership zaati maloomat se.

book_ref.quote: Data ownership refers to the right to control personal information.

rows: Takhleeqi kaam se mutaliq
Apni zaati maloomat par ikhtiyar ka haq
Misalein: software, music, tehreer
Misalein: kisi ka naam, contacts, location
Baghair ijazat copy, share ya istemal na kar ke ehtiram
Zaati data ki hifazat aur ghalat istemal na kar ke ehtiram

blocks.prompt:
70 Give two examples of unethical digital behavior and two of its consequences.
(Ghair-akhlaqi digital rawayye ki do misalein aur is ke do nataij likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Misalein: hacking, jhooti maloomat phailana (aur cyberbullying).
Nataij: saakh kharab hoti hai aur qanooni kaarwai ho sakti hai (doosron ko nuqsan bhi hota hai).

book_ref.quote: Such actions can cause harm, damage reputations, and lead to legal consequences.

blocks.prompt:
71 What are the legal aspects of computing? Define cybercrime.
(Computing ke qanooni pehlu kya hain? Cybercrime ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Computing ke qanooni pehlu woh qawaid hain jo technology aur digital maloomat ke istemal ko chalate hain. Cybercrime computers, networks ya internet se kiye gaye ghair-qanooni kaam hain, maslan hacking, identity theft aur online fraud.

book_ref.quote: Legal aspects of computing refer to the rules and regulations that govern the use of technology and digital information.

blocks.prompt:
72 What is GDPR? Write two things it requires.
(GDPR kya hai? Is ke do taqaze likhein.)
blocks.explanation: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) European Union ka qanoon hai jo zaati data ki hifazat karta aur idaron ke liye data jama, store aur istemal ke qawaid banata hai. Yeh shaffafiyat aur raza mandi (aur maloomat dekhne/delete karne ka haq) maangta hai.

book_ref.quote: It sets rules on how organizations collect, store, and use data.

blocks.prompt:
73 What is PECA 2016? Name two crimes it covers.
(PECA 2016 kya hai? Is mein shamil do jaraim ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) 2016 Pakistan mein cybercrime ka bunyadi qanoon hai; yeh afraad, idaron aur riyasat ki hifazat karta hai. Is mein hacking aur identity theft (aur online fraud, data tak baghair ijazat rasai) shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: It aims to protect individuals, organizations, and the state from illegal activities carried out using computers, mobile devices, and the internet.

blocks.prompt:
74 Write one environmental and one social impact of computing.
(Computing ka aik mahooliyati aur aik samaji asar likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mahooliyati: technology bijli kharch karti, electronic waste banati aur aaloodgi barhati hai.
Samaji: technology samaji rawayye, communication aur saqafat par asar daalti hai.

book_ref.quote: At the same time, technology influences social behavior, communication, and culture.

blocks.prompt:
75 How can the negative environmental impact of technology be reduced?
(Technology ke manfi mahooliyati asar ko kaise kam kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electronic devices ko zimmedari se recycle, reuse aur kam kar ke, energy-efficient devices aur mahol dost tareeqe apna kar, aur e-waste ka sahi intezam kar ke taake wasail bachein aur aaloodgi kam ho.

book_ref.quote: Energy-efficient devices and environmentally friendly practices reduce the negative impact of technology.

blocks.prompt:
76 Write one benefit and one challenge of technology for society.
(Muashre ke liye technology ka aik faida aur aik mushkil likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Faida: technology taleem, sehat aur karobar ki karkardagi behtar karti hai.
Mushkil: yeh digital divide ya privacy ke khatme ka sabab ban sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Technology can improve education, healthcare, and business efficiency.
